newsitem.title: CHILE: Outokumpu '96 Chile copper output rises.
newsitem.headline: Outokumpu '96 Chile copper output rises.

text.p: Finnish mining company Outokumpu Oy said its Chilean Zaldivar mine produced 77,500 tonnes of copper cathodes last year, up from around 25,000 tonnes in 1995.
"We produced 77,500 tonnes last year which we consider reasonably good for the first (full) year of operations," the pit's general manager, Tapani Jarvinen, told Reuters.
The mine, owned equally by Outokumpu and Placer Dome, came on line in June 1995.
The mine expects output to rise to 100,000 tonnes this year and hit full monthly design rate in the last quarter of the year, he said.
"This is absolutely according to our original plan. We must take away waste first and, with the amount of waste we have before we reach our main zone, that takes time," he said.
Zaldivar sees production rising to its top design capacity of 125,000 tonnes in 1998, said Jarvinen.
